title: Chip stocks slide on AI-financing doubts, with memory and equipment hit hardest
intro: Investors questioned how the AI buildout will be paid for: ASML and Applied Materials fell into the week's chip selloff, and SpaceX was reported to be lining up about $40B of debt for Nvidia hardware. The physical bottlenecks did not ease, as Applied flagged cleanroom space, IDC tied a 20% PC slump to AI-driven memory scarcity, and Google locked in 20 years of nuclear power from Constellation.
movers_note: Tracked value fell 1.6% to $33.10T, led by memory (SK hynix −14.2%, Samsung −13.6%) and optics (Lumentum −11.4%, Innolight −9.1%) plus Applied Materials (−8.7%), while Nan Ya PCB (+37.1%, from a Sep 7 quote), Alchip (+7.6%), Meta (+5.8%), Shin-Etsu (+3.1%) and ASE (+2.9%) gained.

items.headline: Applied Materials names cleanroom space as its main near-term limit at SEMICON West
items.summary: Applied set 2030 goals of a 54% non-GAAP gross margin and more than $12B in services revenue, and expects HBM-related revenue above $1B this year. It said China restrictions keep it from serving leading-edge, DRAM and NAND customers there.

items.headline: ASML drops about 3% in a chip selloff driven by AI-financing doubts, a day before Q3 results
items.summary: ASML closed at EUR 1,528.20, roughly 6% lower on the week, as investors questioned how AI buildouts will be funded and Applied Materials declined to forecast industry spending. Third-quarter results are due October 14 before the open.

items.headline: Google signs a 20-year Constellation nuclear deal for 890 MW of uprates plus 2,700 MW from existing plants
items.summary: Constellation will spend more than $4.3B upgrading 11 reactors at six sites to add 890 MW to PJM, and a separate 15-year agreement covers 2,700 MW from existing plants. Constellation also becomes a Google Cloud customer.

items.headline: SpaceX is reported to be seeking about $40B of debt to buy Nvidia AI chips
items.summary: Reuters reports a package of about $10B in bank loans and $30B in investment-grade debt, with Apollo expected to lead and PIMCO also in talks. SpaceX plans to build its data centers exclusively on Nvidia hardware; the financing is not confirmed.

items.headline: IDC: third-quarter PC shipments fell 20.1% to 62.7M units as AI demand squeezes memory
items.summary: IDC said shipments also fell 9.1% from the second quarter, unusual for the season, after channels bought early to beat price rises. It ties the higher component costs to an AI-driven shortage of memory and storage and does not expect prices to return to year-ago levels.

items.headline: Fixer in the Super Micro case pleads guilty over about $2.5B of US AI technology sent to China
items.summary: Ting-Wei Sun admitted four counts including conspiracy to violate export controls; prosecutors say Nvidia-powered servers went through a Southeast Asian company to Chinese buyers. Super Micro is not a defendant, and co-founder Wally Liaw has pleaded not guilty.

items.headline: Senate Democrats' report says data-center operators resist paying for shared grid upgrades
items.summary: A 27-page report from Senators Warren, Blumenthal and Van Hollen covers Amazon, Google, Meta, Microsoft, CoreWeave, Digital Realty and Equinix. It says the firms oppose but-for cost allocation, gave no full data on permanent jobs, and keep seeking NDAs and sales-tax breaks on chips.

items.headline: Wolfspeed gets a conditional $1.5B Department of War loan to expand US SiC and GaN production
items.summary: The 30-year facility comes in four tranches, the first $600M refinancing 2030 notes, and gives the department warrants on up to 7.5% of equity. It depends on converting most convertibles, a $750M minimum contribution from qualifying sources, and final agreements.

items.headline: GlobalFoundries unveils FDX Fusion FD-SOI platform, targeting Dresden production in 2028
items.summary: GF says the platform reaches 7nm-class digital performance with more than twice the density of first-generation FDX, aimed at physical AI, automotive and industrial chips. Demonstrator silicon is due in early 2027 and a design kit in mid-2027.
